title: Music Production
summary: Ambient electronic and other genres, produced, written, mixed and recorded end to end, solo and with other artists.

cover.alt: Black Ø above a leafless tree on a white background

sections.heading: Overview
paragraphs: I make ambient electronic music, among other genres. I handle the whole process myself: producing, composing, writing, mixing, and recording my own voice and instruments.
The work is for personal projects, both solo and alongside other artists, and it is released on Spotify.
